title: Monorepo import contract — xw-platform
description: Frozen rules for importing xhs-registry and xhs-device-agent full git history into the new xw-platform monorepo. Every import operation (F2/F3) MUST declare compliance with this contract. The contract is source-only: it permits source fusion and forbids runtime cutover.

importMethod.mode: fresh HTTPS clone into scratch dir; never touch live clones; never push back to source repos
importMethod.refScoping: MUST pass --refs <importCommit> (read from source-lock.v1.json) so filter-repo rewrites only that SHA and its ancestors, NOT the whole repo history. Without --refs, filter-repo's default rewrites every ref in the fresh clone; if the source-repo tip advances between lock and import, or stray local refs exist, the rewritten tip may diverge from the GitHub merge commit. --refs binds the rewrite to the locked importCommit.

scratch.rules: directory does not exist -> create; directory already exists -> BLOCK; never auto-delete, never overwrite, never clear-and-reuse. This is the only way to guarantee a fresh import free of leftover refs, objects, worktree files, or receipts from a prior import.

historyRequirement: git log --follow must trace every imported path back to the source repo history

verification.blobParity: blob OIDs reused; verify original blobs still present via git cat-file --batch-check
verification.fileCountParity: imported tracked file count equals original tracked file count
verification.sourceTreeMatchesLockNote: receipt.originalTreeSha MUST equal sourceLock.<repo>.importTreeSha and receipt.originalCommit MUST equal sourceLock.<repo>.importCommit
verification.rewrittenTipMapsFromImportCommitNote: git-filter-repo commit-map MUST map sourceLock.<repo>.importCommit -> rewrittenTipCommit
verification.importedCommitBeyondLockCountNote: commits after the locked importCommit accidentally brought into import history MUST be 0 (recorded as advanceCommitCount in the receipt)

receiptTimeline: targetBaseCommit — xw-platform main tip the unrelated-histories merge lands on
rewrittenTipCommit — filter-repo output tip (services/<prefix> subtree, --refs scoped to importCommit)
fusionMergeCommit — git merge --allow-unrelated-histories --no-ff of rewrittenTip into targetBase
receiptSelfCommitNote: The commit that adds this receipt file is queryable via git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/fusion/import-<importId>.v1.json; it is NOT a field in the receipt (self-reference: the SHA only exists after the file is committed). The GitHub PR merge commit is recorded post-merge in acceptance artifacts, not in the import receipt.
